decision: PHASE 09ZG CONTROLLED LOA LIVE PATH INSTRUMENTATION DIAGNOSTIC PASS WITH ROOT CAUSE IDENTIFIED
firstDivergence: All four failing queries never reach pipeline.js: runPipeline() at all. ask-handler.js (line ~2969) runs its own separate Philippine-tax domain-boundary check using the BASE detectPhilippineTaxBoundary() imported directly from services/philippine-tax-domain-boundary.js -- not pipeline.js's exported wrapper, which is the only place the PHASE-09ZE audit-procedure overlay patterns exist. That base allowlist-only check rejects all four phrasings (none contain a recognized keyword such as 'BIR' or 'tax') and ask-handler.js returns immediately with routeKind: DOMAIN_BOUNDARY, before handleControlledRagRoute()/runPipeline() is ever called.
rootCauseFinding: ask-handler.js contains a duplicate, un-overlaid Philippine-tax domain-boundary check that runs before the pipeline and rejects the four audit-procedure queries prior to reaching Step 12.65, pipeline.js's own boundary wrapper, or any 09ZG trace checkpoint. PHASE-09ZE and PHASE-09ZF both correctly modified pipeline.js but neither could have fixed this, since the request never reaches pipeline.js for these four queries.
confidenceLevel: High -- corroborated by static code (ask-handler.js's separate boundary call site and early-return path), live HTTP response fields (routeKind, sourceStatus, responseType, exact BOUNDARY_REJECTION_MESSAGE answer text) for all 6 queries against a verified staging deployment of this exact commit, and elapsed-time evidence (~1s rejection vs ~15-16s full pipeline run).
evidenceLimitations: The [TINA_09ZG_LOA_PATH] events are logged as multi-line console.log output; the Render Logs API's text filter only reliably matched the opening brace line of each event, so full field-level trace reconstruction from the Render log stream was not achieved for every query (a single-line JSON.stringify logging format would resolve this but is a code change out of scope for this findings-only commit). This affected only the log-stream corroboration layer, not the HTTP-response-level evidence, which was captured completely and reliably for all 6 queries.
diagnosticFlagDisabledVia: Render API env-var update, confirmed by read-back (value: false)
